sourceDomain: exact process reference and caller-owned ordinary environment
targetDomain: exact selected value identity or an explicitly coalesced TypeError
forwardMap: parse the exact reference then traverse each named segment in order
reverseMapOrAbsence: absent: traversal loses the reference, environment, path, descriptors, and refusal cause
preservedInformation: terminal value identity and authored segment order
lostInformation: reference text, environment identity, traversed containers, property descriptors, and specific refusal cause
identity: the returned value is the exact data-property value; no clone or normalization occurs
partiality: defined only for exact grammar, safe intermediate containers, and own enumerable data properties
failure: exact grammar container or own-enumerable-data TypeError while proxy trap failures propagate
authorityEffect: read-only traversal of caller-owned ordinary data; no getter invocation and no mutation authority
stateOwner: caller owns the environment and every traversed value; the interpreter owns no state
lifecycle: pure per invocation with no retained state
adapterSeam: surface-process-engine resolves strings beginning with dollar through this interpreter
falsifier: any accepted accessor invocation, inherited or hidden property, unsafe prototype, forbidden segment, malformed syntax, cloned result, or changed refusal text
symmetryBreak: admission rejects ambient roots state, r, and model before execution; runtime traversal separately guards path segments and intermediate containers

targetDomain: profile identity, normalized truth value, string projection, or equality verdict

caller value identity until an explicitly declared coercion is applied
lostInformation: type identity, object identity, canonical parse refusal, and original spelling after stringification
identity: profile sourcery/expression-rel-values/1 and retained operation ordering
partiality: string coercion can invoke caller hooks and propagate their exact failures
failure: canonical typed-literal parse failures become false; String coercion failures propagate by identity
authorityEffect: pure except explicitly invoking caller-owned JavaScript string-coercion hooks
falsifier: strict JSON equality replaces retained coercion
typed parse failure escapes or caller coercion failure is swallowed
operand evaluation or coercion order changes
default: declared nullish, Boolean, typed-parse, and string-equality fallbacks only
